'''Zabraki''', or '''Zabrak''' was the native language of the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from [[Iridonia/Legends|Iridonia]]. Most Zabrak were fluent in both Zabrak language and [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], being literate in both languages.

[[Agen Kolar/Legends|Agen Kolar]] spoke in a "gentle Zabrak baritone", suggesting that that vocal trait was common among the Zabraks.

The word ''Kaz'', as in the name [[Kaz Lo]], meant "clever" or "innovative". The word "Ouc" as in the name "Oucoa" pronounced ''Oak-oa'' meant "Brave" or "Fearless one".
